policy.name: West Bengal Incentive Scheme (WBIS) 2026 for MSMEs (successor to Banglashree for MSMEs, which expired 31.03.2025)

zone_lookup: Unknown - WBIS 2026 notification not obtained. (Banglashree 2020 used Zones A-E per its annexure; not reused here.)

schemes.name: WBIS 2026 Interest subsidy on term loan - Zone A
schemes.notes: RATE IS SHARE OF ANNUAL INTEREST LIABILITY (25%), not percentage points; 5 years from first loan disbursement; loans from commercial/cooperative/scheduled banks, RRBs, FIs for approved projects. Caps unknown. UNVERIFIED: figures only from news reports of the July 2026 cabinet approval (KNN India 20.07.2026 https://knnindia.co.in/news/newsdetails/msme/west-bengal-approves-wbis-2026-msme-incentive-scheme-with-interest-and-power-subsidies ; LegalSuvidha). Official notification not found/readable (wbmsme.gov.in, silpasathi.wb.gov.in, egazette.wb.gov.in unreachable; not posted on wbmsmet.gov.in or myenterprisewb.in as of 2026-10-17). Applies to new manufacturing MSMEs with Udyam Registration commencing commercial production on/after 01.10.2026; units that started on/before 30.09.2026 are excluded. Zone A/B/C definitions not known.

schemes.name: WBIS 2026 Interest subsidy on term loan - Zones B & C
schemes.notes: 35% of annual interest liability, 5 years from first disbursement. Caps unknown. UNVERIFIED: figures only from news reports of the July 2026 cabinet approval (KNN India 20.07.2026 https://knnindia.co.in/news/newsdetails/msme/west-bengal-approves-wbis-2026-msme-incentive-scheme-with-interest-and-power-subsidies ; LegalSuvidha). Official notification not found/readable (wbmsme.gov.in, silpasathi.wb.gov.in, egazette.wb.gov.in unreachable; not posted on wbmsmet.gov.in or myenterprisewb.in as of 2026-10-17). Applies to new manufacturing MSMEs with Udyam Registration commencing commercial production on/after 01.10.2026; units that started on/before 30.09.2026 are excluded. Zone A/B/C definitions not known.

schemes.name: WBIS 2026 Electricity duty waiver
schemes.notes: PARTIAL waiver: 50% of electricity duty in Zone A, 75% in Zones B & C, for 5 years from commercial production; 100% (cap Rs 10 lakh/yr) for micro & small units wholly owned by women or SC/ST entrepreneurs. UNVERIFIED: figures only from news reports of the July 2026 cabinet approval (KNN India 20.07.2026 https://knnindia.co.in/news/newsdetails/msme/west-bengal-approves-wbis-2026-msme-incentive-scheme-with-interest-and-power-subsidies ; LegalSuvidha). No capital investment subsidy for NEW units was reported for WBIS 2026.

Predecessor verified from official notification: Banglashree for MSMEs (No. 1543/MSMET-18011(11)/1/2020 dated 22.07.2020, Kolkata Gazette Extraordinary WB(Part-I)/2020/SAR-642) was in force 01.04.2020-31.03.2025 (para 1), source https://myenterprisewb.in (Banglashree - 22/07/2020 download) - EXPIRED; units commencing production 01.04.2025-30.09.2026 appear to have no MSME incentive scheme.
West Bengal also enacted a 2025 Act revoking older industrial incentive schemes (reported); not relevant to MSME scheme figures.
